comment: Dr. Litteral is a great professor. He did well in fulfilling the introductory FYS requirements of writing papers and giving presentations and confirmed that I was up to speed for college level writing.

Very nice man, but confusing teacher. He actually makes to topic more confusing explaining in class and some days I felt that I would be better off spending my class period learning the topic myself. He is very helpful though outside of class and I learned a lot doing that and he considered that effort when grading. Work hard on the final project.

Despite what people say, Dr. Litteral is a good guy who wants to help his students. His chocolate FYS was all over the place because it was his first time teaching it, but it wasn't a bad FYS at all. Not a lot of reading, he met the 5000 word requirement for writing. His feedback on papers sucks, but if you know how to write you're fine.

Litteral is extremely rude to his students. I have him for the chocolate/slavery/business FYS and I haven't dreaded a class more. You'll do nothing for two weeks and then all the sudden he'll spring 5 assignments on you. He admitted he's making the class up as he goes. The content is random and I won't take much away from this course. Avoid it.
Dr. Litteral clearly cares about his students. The material for B-Stats is difficult, but Dr. Litteral wants students to do well. I enjoyed my experience in Dr. Litteral's class very much.
If you have taken and done well in AP Statistics you will do fine. Material is not hard; however, he does not teach anything in class. Very willing to meet with you outside of class.
Avoid please. I'm not sure if I learned anything from this course. And it single-handedly killed my GPA.

I'm in Water, this class is a disaster. One of the only seminars that doesn't get to submit drafts we learn nothing in class and have awful discussions. I liked this topic before but turns out he knows nothing on the subject. He is a very harsh paper grader although he admitted to students he doesn't actually read the papers. DON'T TAKE!

This guy is seriously bad. Stay away from him. The class is okay, but he doesn't care about his students. Asked him on how to improve presentation, I did pretty well but he said to look for other students to see how to improve, showing that he doesn't even know himself how you did. He doesnt care. Don't take any class with him.
Nice guy, smart, easy paper grader. Not too much homework. You just cant screw around in his class.
He is clearly a very smart teacher. I really liked him as a person. He cares alot about his class and if you give him a chance he is a really decent and interesting teacher. I really liked the class!

He's very interested in the FYS Water: Economics, Politics, and Policy.  He lets us guide the class discussion and keep the class engaged.  He's very helpful in decided on paper topics and guiding you in the right direction.  I would suggest taking his FYS.
STAY AWAY.
Worst professor I have had at Richmond.  Impossible to understand and tests are extremely difficult.  ABSOLUTELY DO NOT TAKE!  I couldn't possibly recommend a professor less...
Very difficult class with him as a teacher.  Very unclear and unorganized in explaining concepts. DO NOT take.

Very hard professor.  Very knowledgeable about statistics, but not the best at explaining it, even if you go to see him. He expects a lot from you.  There are only 4 grades the whole semester, so effort or improvement, etc will not get you any credit.
Intimidating man but he is really nice if you get to know him.
He is the most arrogant man I've ever met.  He can not answer questions you have and is not helpful one bit.  I do not recommend him.
He is a hard teacher but he is not that bad afterall. First test is extremely hard but second is much easier. Just study and you'll be fine.
Stay away from him. Horrible tests and sense of humor. He doesn't know how to teach and require to know a lot.

Difficult class but fairly good teacher. I can tell he put a lot of work into revamping the class so that statistics is somewhat enjoyable. Very strict about lateness and other Southern chivalry things but is very smart and tries to help. Don't get on his bad side though.
No Comments
he isn't that hard regardless of whether you pay attention or not, and his tests are straightforward. He is helpful when something may seem confusing.  Don't be late to class and you will be fine!
Avoid this professor

He is a nice guy with a unique sense of humor.  As long as you attend class, do the homework, and go to him with anything you don't understand you will be fine.  He is extremely helpful outside of class and is a genuinely nice guy.

This is a fair professor. However, I echo the sentiment that his 8:15 stats class puts an undue burden on students. He doesn't teach so much as expects students to know everything already before coming to class. Horribly frustrating. Subject matter is dull -- as are his attempts at rapport with the students (which hardly exist to begin with).
Horrible, try to avoid him.
don't be late (ever, not even by 20 seconds) do the homework, you'll do fine. dry sense of humor but available for help, very good w/ office hours
No Comments

He's definitely a hard professor, and don't EVER be late to his class, but he's fair.  I'm horrible at statistics but managed to do okay in his class because I WAS forced to be there and listen and do the homework.  It's a pretty elementary approach to a college class, but if you need the discipline you'll get it.  And if you don't know something, he'll help you understand it.
didn't really teach anything, relied on students to know what was going on by themselves
Hates late ppl, bad at explaining things. Really bad handwriting, hard to follow when he talks. Awful for an 8.15. Better take someone else, Nicholson, for instance, he's awesome.
Funny teacher.  Just do well on the quizzes, go to all the classes, participate, and you'll get an A in the class.
The tests were extremely hard but he taught the subject well and was very easy to get help from outside of class.  Was very anal about getting to class on time but overall a nice guy.
No Comments

He was helpful and clear for the class BUT - this class seemed disproportionally hard for a statistics class. It was an unexpeceted burden, because there is a VERY few number of grades - you screw up a couple times and its a C or worse. It's boring but that's a result of the subject, not the teacher

Dr. Litteral is a good teacher, just hates late people.  He seriously will hold a grudge against you for weeks if you are a minute late.  Do well on the first two tests and you will have it a lot easier by the end of the semester.

Dr. Litteral is a good teacher, but sometimes has his quirks.  Don't ever be tardy for his class, and if you don't know something then keep your mouth shut because he has good days and bad days.  Helpful out of class, and unforgivingly short tests.
